blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Government Service Insurance System (GSIS) is offering nearly P8 billion in emergency loans available to more than 317,000 members and pensioners affected by flooding and other damage from recent typhoons and the enhanced southwest monsoon. According to a GSIS statement issued on Friday, a total of 317,721 active members and old-age and disability pensioners in 16 areas in Luzon and Mindanao may avail themselves of an emergency loan of up to P40,000. The affected areas were placed under a state of calamity following flooding, property damage, and other disruptions caused by Typhoons Luis, Maymay, and Neneng and the […]...
